title: Case 409

plan.situation: Ticket CD-5521: Marta Hollis has asked us to book air freight for a crated harpsichord (declared value CAD 22,000) from YYC to YZF, and it must arrive before the 18 Oct recital. Option A (turboprop, CAD 880) has a 107 cm piece-height and 180 kg weight limit, and its allocation expires Tue 13 Oct 12:00 MDT. Option B (charter, CAD 1,940) needs commitment by Wed 14 Oct 12:00 MDT. Marta's own figures (98 cm uncrated + 12 cm runners = 110 cm before foam and lid) already exceed Option A's height limit. The crated weight (~175 kg on a bathroom scale) is unverified, and nobody has measured the crated dimensions. The carrier and the insurer both need those dimensions. Marta is back at the shop Tuesday morning.

facts.fact: Uncrated size 240 x 95 x 98 cm, ~150 kg, declared value CAD 22,000, needed by Sun 18 Oct
Option A: Thu 15 Oct, CAD 880, max piece height 107 cm, max 180 kg, oversize refused at acceptance with CAD 120 fee not refunded, allocation held to Tue 13 Oct 12:00 MDT
Option B: Fri 16 Oct, CAD 1,940, up to 400 kg / 1.6 m height, commitment by Wed 14 Oct 12:00 MDT
Both options require final crated dimensions and gross weight for the air waybill
Rowan prefers the cheaper option but does not want to take any risk of damage
Crate has 12 cm cradle runners underneath plus a foam top and a screwed lid; crated weight 'about 175 kg, bathroom scale'; crated dimensions not entered; the photo's tape reading is not legible
Workshop is closed Wed-Fri; Marta is back Tuesday morning; pickup possible Tue 10:00 onwards
Cordova Mutual binds CAD 22,000 cover only once the crated dimensions and gross weight are supplied; premium CAD 198 for either option
Minimum crated height = 98 + 12 = 110 cm, 3 cm over Option A's 107 cm limit before adding foam and lid
Estimated weight 175 kg is only 5 kg under the 180 kg limit and comes from a bathroom scale
Carrier reminder: Option A expires Tue 13 Oct 12:00 MDT; there are other enquiries for the flight

conflicts: The suggestion that Option A is suitable (cheaper, Rowan's preference) conflicts with the shipper's own figures, which put the crate at 110 cm or more against a 107 cm door limit; only a measured crate from Marta can settle this
Crated weight is a bathroom-scale estimate (~175 kg) against a hard 180 kg limit; unverified
missing_information: Measured external crated length, width and height (cm), including runners, foam and lid
Gross crated weight from a reliable scale
Who authorises and pays for the booking, and whether they accept Option B at CAD 1,940 (CAD 1,060 more than A) if Option A is ruled out
Confirmation of the pickup time from the workshop (Tue 10:00 onwards stated)
risk_flags: Booking Option A on unverified figures risks refusal at acceptance, losing the CAD 120 fee and missing the 18 Oct deadline
Deadline: Option A allocation ends Tue 13 Oct 12:00 MDT; Option B commitment by Wed 14 Oct 12:00 MDT
Insurance for CAD 22,000 is not bound until the crated dimensions are supplied
Carrier pressure about 'other enquiries' is not a reason to book on estimates
Money: committing either fare is a spending commitment that needs the payer's mandate

authority_map.controls: Crated dimensions and weight data, crate build, pickup readiness; booking instruction as requester
Buyer preference (cheaper unless risk); no recorded payment mandate
Acceptance limits, allocation and fare for Options A and B
Binding the CAD 22,000 cover once crated dimensions and weight are supplied
Placing the booking only on the payer's instruction; no standing pre-authorisation to commit CAD 1,940

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: The desk has made no earlier promise to Marta. The carrier's reminder (event 007) brings no new fact. The booking decision is due today.
wait_check.pending_promise: none from the requester; carrier Option A allocation held to Tue 13 Oct 12:00 MDT, Option B to Wed 14 Oct 12:00 MDT

plan.decision_summary: Do not book Option A on estimates. Marta's own figures put the crate at 110 cm or more against a 107 cm limit. Ask Marta for the measured crated dimensions and a weighed gross weight on Tuesday morning, plus her instruction on Option B (CAD 1,940), so the booking and insurance can go ahead before the Option B cutoff on Wed 14 Oct 12:00 MDT.
plan.rationale: Both the carrier and the insurer need the crated dimensions and weight, and only Marta can supply them. Her stated figures already exceed Option A's door height, and refusal at acceptance would lose the fee and probably the recital date. Rowan does not want any risk. Committing CAD 1,940 needs the payer's mandate, so the desk asks for it rather than deciding. Marta is back Tuesday morning, which leaves time to measure before the Option A allocation lapses at 12:00 and well before the Option B cutoff on Wednesday.

actions.subject: CD-5521 harpsichord YYC-YZF: crated measurements and booking choice needed Tue 13 Oct
actions.body:
Hi Marta,

We can't book the flight yet. Both the airline and the insurer need measured figures for the finished crate.

Option A (turboprop, Thu 15 Oct, CAD 880) only accepts pieces up to 107 cm high and 180 kg. Your figures are 98 cm for the instrument plus 12 cm cradle runners, which is already 110 cm before the foam top and lid. The crate weight of about 175 kg from a bathroom scale is also close to the limit. If a piece is over the limit, the airline refuses it at acceptance and keeps the CAD 120 acceptance fee. That would put the 18 Oct recital at risk. So we are not booking Option A on the current estimates.

When you are back at the shop on Tuesday 13 Oct, please send us:
1. The measured outside length, width and height of the crate in cm, including runners, foam and lid.
2. The gross weight of the crate from a proper scale, if you can.
3. Your instruction on which option to book. Option B is the charter freighter on Fri 16 Oct, CAD 1,940, which takes up to 1.6 m high and 400 kg. Please also tell us who is paying for the freight.

Timings: if the measured crate does fit Option A, we would need your reply before Tue 13 Oct 12:00 MDT, when the airline stops holding that space. Option B has to be confirmed by Wed 14 Oct 12:00 MDT. Please reply by Tue 13 Oct 11:00 MDT if you can.

Cordova Mutual will put the CAD 22,000 cover in place once we send them the same measured figures. The premium is CAD 198 for either option.

This is a request for information. Nothing is booked yet, and nothing will be until you confirm.

Dev Okafor, Bowline Cargo Desk
actions.purpose: Get the measured crate figures and the payer's booking instruction from the only party who has them, before the carrier deadlines.

actions.body: CD-5521: Option A not booked. Stated figures give a crated height of at least 110 cm (98 + 12 runners) against the 107 cm limit, and the weight is a bathroom-scale 175 kg against the 180 kg limit. Asked Marta for measured crated L x W x H, gross weight and an instruction on Option B (CAD 1,940; CAD 1,060 more than A), plus who pays. Deadlines: A Tue 13 Oct 12:00 MDT, B Wed 14 Oct 12:00 MDT. Insurance (CAD 198) waits for the measured figures. Committing a fare needs payer approval (hard gate).
actions.purpose: Record the reasoning and deadlines for the shift.

actions.body: Tue 13 Oct 09:00 MDT: check for Marta's measurements and instruction. If none, contact her through the recorded channel as soon as she is back at the shop. Option A lapses at 12:00 MDT. If there is still no reply by Tue afternoon, escalate to the supervisor ahead of the Option B cutoff on Wed 14 Oct 12:00 MDT.
actions.purpose: Make sure the reply arrives before the Option A and Option B cutoffs.

not_doing: Not booking Option A on estimates: stated figures already exceed the height limit, and a refusal loses CAD 120 and risks the deadline
Not committing Option B (CAD 1,940) without the payer's instruction
Not replying to the carrier with a commitment or asking for an extension it has not offered
Not sending estimated dimensions to Cordova Mutual or the carrier
Not promising Rowan an arrival date or that insurance is in place
Not suggesting the crate travel on its side or be rebuilt; that is the shipper's decision
plan.follow_up: Tue 13 Oct 09:00 MDT: check for Marta's measured crate figures and booking instruction. If they confirm a fit under 107 cm and 180 kg before 12:00, Option A can be considered with the payer's approval. Otherwise prepare Option B for human approval before Wed 14 Oct 12:00 MDT. Then send the figures to Athabasca and Cordova Mutual. If Marta is silent by Tuesday afternoon, escalate to the supervisor before the Option B cutoff.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Do not book Option A on estimates. Marta's own figures put the crate at 110 cm or more against a 107 cm limit. Ask Marta for the measured crated dimensions and a weighed gross weight on Tuesday morning, plus her instruction on Option B (CAD 1,940), so the booking and insurance can go ahead before the Option B cutoff on Wed 14 Oct 12:00 MDT.

issues.problem: The 110 cm minimum height assumes the instrument sits on top of the 12 cm runners. That is a reasonable reading of 'cradle runners underneath', but it is still an inference. The message does present it as 'your figures' and asks for a measurement, so it is not a false claim.
issues.fix: Optional: say 'on the figures we have' so it reads as an estimate. No change is required.

issues.problem: Marta says she is back Tuesday morning, but the record does not say whether she reads email on Monday. Asking for a reply by 11:00 leaves her very little time to measure the crate before Option A lapses at 12:00.
issues.fix: No change needed. The 09:00 follow-up covers this.

review.summary: The plan holds off booking Option A on estimated figures, which already look over the height limit. It asks Marta, the only person who can measure the crate, for the crated dimensions, a proper weight and her instruction on booking and payment. Every figure, deadline and calculation matches the record (110 cm, CAD 1,060 difference, 15:00Z = 09:00 MDT), nothing is presented as booked or insured, and the carrier's pressure to commit is not acted on.
